newsitem.title: USA: Riser says agrees to merge with Giant Eagle.
newsitem.headline: Riser says agrees to merge with Giant Eagle.

text.p: Riser Foods Inc said Wednesday it has reached an agreement to merge with Giant Eagle Inc, a privately held retail supermarket chain and wholesale distributor, for a total value of $403 million.
Riser said Giant Eagle will acquire all its outstanding class A and B stock for $42 per share. Giant Eagle will also assume about $47 million of debt and acquire existing options.
The company said the deal will be financed under a firm commitment that Giant Eagle has received from a major U.S. bank.
